finding: Actual Rulebench proof capsules passed an independently implemented Lotus checker through a fixed-source adapter and preserved source binding.
limitations: Local, fixed-source one-step transfer; type-validation gaps retained. No live transport/deployment or real approval tested.
Node.js 22.13+ and Python 3; no third-party package installation or network is required by the archived recipe. This is a focused source snapshot, not full repository suites.

Upstream private-source snapshots, both recorded runs and rejection cases remain in the original ZIP. Final run-002 is selected for direct browsing; run-001 is not silently pooled with it. Source validation gaps remain disclosed.
This assembly inherits the recorded scientific checks and does not establish deployment behavior or public permission.

Preserved archive: RELATION-TRANSFER-001-REPRODUCIBLE-PACKET.zip. The attached files are inspection selections; they do not replace its complete runtime directory. No public archive URL or permission is implied. Full figures, historical versions and omitted dependencies remain in that archive.
Public source selections omit specified private identifiers or provenance-sensitive inputs; private originals and source hashes remain preserved.
method: A fixed-source one-step adapter translates actual generated capsules. The archived local run retains independently implemented checks, source/target fixtures, binding records, model-set comparison and adversarial controls.
open_questions: Further generalization remains a separate research question; it is not a prerequisite for presenting the recorded bounded outcome.
